Privacy Policy — Create my AI Context

Last updated: July 2026 · Version 0.4.5

Create my AI Context is a Chrome extension that helps you turn notes or files into a compact English AI context pack using Chrome’s on-device Gemini Nano (Prompt API).

Data we process

Text, titles, objectives, constraints, uploaded files you choose, and generated context packs you enter or create are processed only on your device.

What we do not do

  • We do not upload your source text, files, or packs to AI4Context servers.
  • We do not sell or share your content with third parties.
  • We do not read your browsing history or other tabs (this extension does not request tab-content permissions for that purpose).

Local storage

Preferences (such as UI language) and packs you explicitly save to the library may be stored with chrome.storage.local on your device. You can clear extension data from Chrome’s settings.

On-device AI

Model inference uses Chrome’s built-in Prompt API / Gemini Nano when available. That processing stays under Chrome’s on-device AI stack on your machine.

Contact

Questions about this policy: use the developer contact on the Chrome Web Store listing for Create my AI Context, or the AI4Context site associated with the publisher account.
